entries.text: Greece – Panhellenic Exams: the main papers of 2019 and 2022–2025 re-transcribed from the official Ministry papers and source-checked (20 themes); the repeat and Greeks-abroad papers of those years are withdrawn until they are redone.

Greece Panhellenic 2016–2026: 20 themes checked against the official Ministry papers; the other June papers of 2017–2025 differ from the official sheets and are listed in the audit report, no text changed.
HMMT Invitational (HMIC) 2013–2026 and Tuymaada senior 2025–2026: 86 statements checked against the official PDFs, no changes needed.
Korea KJMO 2009–2015: 56 statements checked against the official Korean papers; 5 corrected (2009 P5, 2011 P2, 2012 P2 and P4, 2015 P3).
India RMO: 79 problems added from the official HBCSE papers (2002 and further regional papers of 2012–2014, 2016, 2018, 2023, 2025); 180 statements of 2001–2025 checked against them, 15 corrected.
Korea KMO Second Round 2009–2025: 132 statements checked against the official Korean papers; 2009 Problem 8 corrected.
Korea Final Round (FKMO) 2009–2026: all 108 statements checked against the official Korean papers.
Hong Kong Preliminary Selection Contest: 2018–2025 added (160 problems) from the official question books; 2002–2017 checked against them (13 statements corrected).
Croatia national final 1997–2005: all 36 statements compared again with the original sheets; wording of 1999 P4 and 2003 P2 aligned with the original.
Romania TST: further tests of 2016, 2019 and 2022 (26 problems).
JBMO Shortlist 2015 (18 problems, possibly incomplete).
New row Baltic Way Shortlist: the 2011 shortlist (52 problems), grouped with Baltic Way.
Taiwan TST: 2011 Round 1, 2013 Round 3 and 2023 (50 problems), English and Chinese.
Taiwan Mathematical Olympiad 2023 (5 problems), English and Chinese.
USA TST 2001, 2003, 2004, 2006, 2007, 2009–2011 (60 problems) from the official MAA booklets.
New row HMMT Invitational (HMIC): all papers 2013–2026 (70 problems), official HMMT archive.
New row Turkey EGMO TST: 2014–2017, 2019, 2022–2025 (54 problems).
Balkan MO Shortlist 2015 (22 problems) — the senior shortlist is now complete 2007–2025.
Hong Kong CHKMO 2023 (4 problems).
Korea KMO First Round 2017–2022: both papers (Euler and Gauss) of each year, 250 problems, English and Korean.
Tuymaada senior league: 2025 and 2026 (official booklets) and 2017 (jury report in Kvant) — 24 problems.
Korea KJMO 2016–2025 (76 problems) from the official papers, English and Korean.
Korea KMO First Round 2023–2026 (80 problems) from the official papers, English and Korean.
Taiwan TST: 2022 and 2024 papers (63 problems).
New country Honduras: Honduran Mathematical Olympiad (OHM), national final, top level, 2007, 2010–2025 (95 problems, English and Spanish).
China TST: 2004 and 2009 added (41 problems); 2020 marked as not held.
Yasinskyi Geometry Olympiad: junior papers (grades 8–9) 2017–2025 added, 68 problems.
New row Yasinskyi Geometry Olympiad (grades 10–11), 2017–2025, 52 problems, from the official papers.
Belgium OMB MINI: 2013 P4 added from the official English paper; 1988–2019 now complete.
New country Pakistan: National Mathematics Olympiad, Seniors, 2007, 2008, 2010, 2011 (18 problems).
New row Belgium OMB MINI (youngest category of the Belgian olympiad), 1988–2019, 132 problems, with the French text.
Ukraine final 2000–2004, 2006–2008 and 2012 added for grades 9, 10 and 11 (221 problems).

Belgium Flanders MO: 1990 P1, 2010 P1, P4 and 2012 P1 added from corrected sheets; all 164 problems of 1986–2026 now in.
New row Belgium Flanders MO (Vlaamse Wiskunde Olympiade, final round), 1986–2026, 160 problems.
New row Turkey Junior First Round (TÜBİTAK middle-school olympiad), 1999–2026, 797 problems, with the Turkish text.
The grid now marks with a dash the years in which a competition was not held (e.g. IMO 1980, many 2020 finals); LaTeX export draws arcs with \wideparen (yhmath).
Olimpiada de Mayo 2022, 2023, 2025 and 2026 added (both levels, 40 problems, with the Portuguese text).
Rioplatense Level 3: 1999 Problems 4–6 added (with the Spanish original) — the row is now complete for 1997–2025 as held.
Turkey First Round: the senior 2026 paper replaces a junior paper sent by mistake; 2022 P6, P7 and 2025 P29 corrected from corrected contributed files and the official Turkish booklet.
Turkey First Round 2019–2026: 256 multiple-choice problems (32 per year), from contributed papers.
Spain – EvAU (Madrid), Matemáticas II, 2011–2026: 252 problems, each with the Spanish original (EN/ES switch).
Slovenia 1973–2000 checked against the Slovene originals in Presek: 10 statements corrected, 1980 Problem 4 added.
Rioplatense Level 3: 2019 added.
Italy – Maturità (Liceo Scientifico), mathematics, 2001–2026: 264 problems.
France – Baccalauréat, spécialité mathématiques, 2021–2026: 162 exercises.

Poland – Matura, mathematics (extended level), 2015–2026: 172 tasks.

UK – STEP 1987–2025: 1,532 questions.
India – JEE Advanced, mathematics, 2007–2025: 732 questions.
Rioplatense Level 3: 1998, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2012–2018, 2022 and 2023 added (78 problems).
North Macedonia: 1995 completed and 1997, 2003–2005 added — the national olympiad is now continuous 1994–2026.
Pan-American Girls' Mathematical Olympiad 2021–2026: all six editions.
Venezuela OJM final 2004–2024 completed.
Moldova national olympiad: 2014–2025 added.
Cyprus – Pancyprian Exams 2010–2026: 255 problems, Greek and English.

Kazakhstan national olympiad, grades 9 and 10.
